title: T9 — Change control (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Change Control — T9 TOGAF ADM capability

## Change requests

One change row is recorded for T9's retrospective window: **Complete T9's retrospective
lifecycle record** — the charter, frozen scope baseline, seven A–D artefacts, Statement of
Architecture Work, delivery contract, Phase-G review, twelve declared outputs and the closure
review are recorded through the product's actions. It changes no table, action or contract; it
names the out-of-sequence closure (`U3-EXC-T9`) and the six open findings the review carries.

## Impact

None on scope, schedule or cost: the capability code is unchanged by this pass. The risk it
records is that the record now supports the closure instead of leaving it implicit; the six
open findings (v1-p81-4, v1-p81-5, v1-p81-6 and their siblings) remain work packages.

## Decisions

| Decision | Gate | State |
|---|---|---|
| The charter of the rework | `charter` | approved, distinct approver |
| The frozen scope baseline | `baseline` | approved, distinct approver |
| The closure request | `closure` | approved, distinct approver |
| The destructive close | `projects.close` | approved, typed evidence = the closure asset |
| The lifecycle-record change | `change` | approved, distinct approver |
